description:
Set the billing address

Sets the company name, address and VAT id printed on your invoices, the same form as in the billing settings. It replaces the whole address: send every field each time, because `companyName` and `vatId` are cleared when left out; the saved address is `billingAddress` in `get_my_account`. `country` is a country name or ISO code; an unknown country is refused with 400. Only the account owner can call this; a team member gets 403. To change the account name use `update_profile`.

body.description: The request fields as one JSON object.
